target.statement_es: Bisección sobre [a,b] con tolerancia tol > 0, tol < b−a, f continua en [a,b] y f(a)·f(b) < 0. El programa termina y al terminar existe una raíz c ∈ (a,b) con u−l ≤ tol, |c−xmid| ≤ (b−a)/2^iter ≤ tol, y iter = ⌈log₂((b−a)/tol)⌉.
target.program_template:
zstore st =
  iter :: "nat"
  fl   :: "real"
  fu   :: "real"
  l    :: "real"
  u    :: "real"
  xmid :: "real"
  ymid :: "real"

program bisection "(f :: real \<Rightarrow> real, a :: real, b :: real, tol :: real)" over st
 = "iter := 0; fl := f(a); fu := f(b); l := a; u := b; xmid := l;
    while u - l > tol
    invariant __INVARIANT__
    variant __VARIANT__
    do iter := iter + 1; xmid := (l + u)/2; ymid := f(xmid);
       if fl*ymid > 0 then l := xmid; fl := ymid else u := xmid; fu := ymid fi od"
target.fixes: f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and a b tol :: real
target.assumes:
postive_tolerance: "0 < tol"
    and sufficiently_small_tol: "tol < b-a"
    and continuous_f: "continuous_on {a..b} f"
    and opposite_signs: "f(a)*f(b)<0"
target.concl: H[True] bisection(f,a,b,tol) [\<exists> c::real. f(c) = 0 \<and> c \<in> {a<..<b} \<and> u-l \<le> tol \<and> \<bar>c-xmid\<bar> \<le> (b-a)/2^iter \<and> \<bar>c-xmid\<bar> \<le> tol \<and> iter = \<lceil>log 2 ((b-a) / tol)\<rceil>]
